title: Recovering topological information of light by topological learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.06542v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The evolution of modern-day communication networks towards optical solutions with enhanced capacity and robustness is driving interest in topological light waves, exploiting their stability against perturbations through a topological invariant, e.g., the skyrmion number. However, detecting the underlying topology remains a computationally intense process even under ideal conditions, becoming intractable after passing through strongly disordered channels, where the degradation into unrecognisable speckle appears to destroy the topology. Here, we propose and demonstrate a topology-enhanced artificial intelligence (AI) approach to recover and classify such apparently lost topological information by computationally leveraging topological invariants in the data across many length scales. translated_title: 通过拓扑学习恢复光的拓扑信息
translated_abstract: 现代通信网络正朝着容量更大、鲁棒性更强的光学解决方案演进，这推动了对拓扑光波的研究兴趣——这类光波借助拓扑不变量（如斯格明子数）实现对扰动的稳定性。然而，即使在理想条件下，检测其底层拓扑仍是一个计算量极其繁重的过程；而在光经过强无序信道后，这一检测变得几乎无法实现，因为光会退化为无法辨认的散斑，看起来拓扑信息已被彻底破坏。在此，我们提出并演示了一种拓扑增强的人工智能（AI）方法，通过在计算上跨多个长度尺度利用数据中的拓扑不变量，来恢复并分类这些表面上已丢失的拓扑信息。通过将信息的拓扑分类与光自身的拓扑对齐，我们的拓扑增强学习协议（称为TOPO²）实现了……
tldr: 提出名为TOPO²的拓扑增强学习协议，通过在多个长度尺度上利用拓扑不变量，使AI能够从强无序信道产生的散斑图像中恢复并分类看似已丢失的光的拓扑信息。
en_tdlr: The proposed TOPO² topology-enhanced learning protocol leverages topological invariants across many length scales, enabling AI to recover and classify apparently lost topological information of light from speckle patterns caused by strongly disordered channels.
